8 Solutions to Fix ‘Find My Friends Location Not Available’ On Motorola Defy 2

There is no doubt that Find My Friends is an excellent application for location tracking. It allows users to track the location of their friends and family members through a variety of devices. So, when Find My Friends says the location is not available, it can be a frustrating situation. But don’t stress over this because we are here to assist you in Find My Friends not working. Go through this guide, and you’ll know what to do to take care of the problem.

Part 1: What Does “Location Not Available” Mean on Find My Friends?

When the “Location Not Available” message appears on Find My Friends, it means that you have disabled location sharing or have turned off your device’s location services. This message can also appear if your device is in an area with poor network coverage or if your device is turned off. In some cases, the message can indicate that you have logged out of your iCloud account or that there is an issue with the iCloud server.

Does “Location Not Available” mean that there is something wrong with Motorola Defy 2 ?

Not! This message does not necessarily mean that you have blocked yourself or there is something wrong with your device. If you frequently see the “Location Not Available” message, you may need to check your own device’s settings or contact your friends to confirm their location-sharing preferences.

How to distinguish “No Location Found” and “Location Not Available”?

“No Location Found” means that the Find My app is unable to locate the Motorola Defy 2 device being tracked. This can happen for a variety of reasons, such as if the Motorola Defy 2 device is turned off, not connected to the internet, or if location services are disabled.

“Location Not Available” means that the Motorola Defy 2 device is not currently sharing its location with the Find My app. This can happen if the Motorola Defy 2 device is in Airplane mode or if the user has turned off location sharing for the Find My app. It can also happen if there is a temporary issue with the iCloud servers.

In summary, “No Location Found” means the app could not locate the Motorola Defy 2 device, while “Location Not Available” means that the Motorola Defy 2 device is not currently sharing its location.

  • The Location Services are also turned off on the friend’s device

After verifying that the feature is available in your region, enable the GPS & Location Services. In case you’ve already enabled the feature, turn it off, quit the app, and again enable the service. Tip 3: Adjust Motorola Defy 2 Date and Time

Tip 4: Check the Internet

Before you conclude that there is something wrong with the Find My Friends app, check your internet connection. There is a chance that location is not available on the Motorola Defy 2 because your device doesn’t have internet access. Try opening Settings > Mobile Data/Wi-Fi and turning it on and off. Tip 5: Enable Share My Location

Another tip to try out when your friend’s location is not available is to make certain that you’ve enabled Share My Location feature. To do this, follow the steps given below:

Step 1: For Motorola Defy 2 users: get to the “Settings” app and go to “Privacy & Security”. You will find the “Location Services” feature, click on it, and see the “Share My Location” feature.

Toggle on the option to enable it. Once the feature is enabled, your friends will see your location, and you can see theirs.

“No Location Found” means that the Find My app is unable to locate the Poco F5 5G device being tracked. This can happen for a variety of reasons, such as if the Poco F5 5G device is turned off, not connected to the internet, or if location services are disabled.

“Location Not Available” means that the Poco F5 5G device is not currently sharing its location with the Find My app. This can happen if the Poco F5 5G device is in Airplane mode or if the user has turned off location sharing for the Find My app. It can also happen if there is a temporary issue with the iCloud servers.
